settings.title: How can we help?
settings.text: If talking to a real-life human is more your thing, you can reach our Customer Happiness Team via email (below).

settings.title: FAQ
Can I place an order without creating an account?
settings.answer: Yes, you can place an order without creating an account by checking out as a guest. However, creating an account allows you to save shipping and billing information, view your order history, and track current orders.

settings.title: How can I place an order online?
settings.answer: You can create an account or proceed with guest checkout.

settings.title: How can I confirm my order?
settings.answer:
Once you place an order, we will send an order confirmation to the e-mail address provided at checkout. The order confirmation* is an invoice and includes all your relevant order details.

* Note that this is not an acceptance of your order but a confirmation that we have received your order.

settings.title: Can I modify or update my order?
settings.answer:
It is possible if the item(s) has not yet entered into manufacturing or has not shipped.

To modify or cancel your order:

  • Contact our Customer Care team if you want to change your existing order.
  • Our Customer Care team will help facilitate feasible changes before the order enters the shipping queue.

settings.title: Can I check my order status online?
settings.answer:
Log in to your account and click the Orders tab on the left. Under status, your order* is either Received, In Process, or Shipped. 

* Please note: We will update the status of your order throughout your order’s progress.

settings.title: Ordering
How are prices and exchange rates determined for international payments?
settings.answer:
Item prices may vary depending on the destination country or region and the currency used to pay for the items.

To ensure the most accurate pricing, taxes, and delivery fees while browsing, please select the desired shipping country at the bottom of any page.

settings.title: What payment methods do you accept?
settings.answer: The Future Rocks accepts payment via Visa, MasterCard, American Express, Apple Pay, and Google Pay. Customers shopping from Belgium and the Netherlands can also pay via Bancontact or iDEAL.

settings.title: How do I know if my card is charged?
settings.answer: When placing an order, the funds allocated for that purchase will be temporarily on hold -- this is the standard pre-authorization period. While this is not an official charge, it is a step towards ensuring sufficient funds are in the account to complete the transaction.

settings.title: Is my order payment safe and secured?
settings.answer: As an online retailer, your data and information security are of the utmost importance to us. Our systems are thorough, secure, and rigorous, ensuring that all personal data shared is protected and explicitly confidential. Learn more about our Privacy Policy here.

settings.title: Payment information
Do you offer international shipping?
settings.answer: You will enjoy free international delivery for all orders over USD 300. We currently ship internationally to 23 markets, including Australia, Austria, Belgium, Canada, France, Germany, Hong Kong SAR, Hungary, Iceland, Ireland, Italy, Japan, Macao SAR, Netherlands, Portugal, Singapore, South Korea, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, Taiwan, United Arab Emirates, United Kingdom and the United States.

settings.title: What are my shipping charges?
settings.answer: Orders over USD 300 will be eligible for free shipping. If your order is below USD 300, shipping charges will vary based on the delivery address and your chosen shipping method.

settings.title: How long does shipping take?
settings.answer:
Standard order processing takes up to 2 business days. Please keep in mind that during peak periods, processing times may exceed two business days.

If you place an order after 11:00 AM (EST), it may be processed the following business day. Orders placed on weekends and holidays will be processed the following business day starting at 8:00 AM (EST).

settings.title: How will my order be packaged?
settings.answer:
Your jewelry comes in a box made from uncoated pulp-colored papers and boards with a rough surface. It is light-fast, pure ECF, and FSC® certified.

Environmental features:

  • Acid-free
  • Heavy metal absence CE 94/62
  • Environmental chlorine free
  • Long life ISO 9706
  • FSC C015523

settings.title: Can I track my delivery online?
settings.answer: Log in to your account here and click the Orders tab on the left. Under status, your order is either Received, In Process, or Shipped. Please note that we will update the status of your order throughout your order’s progress.

settings.title: Do I have to pay duties and taxes?
settings.answer:
If the final price includes duties and taxes at check out, you will not be required to pay any additional fees on delivery.

Your local customs authority determines duties, taxes, and fees; payment of these fees is obligatory if you wish to obtain your order.

For international returns, any import duties paid at checkout are non-refundable. These fees are paid directly to government authorities, and we are unable to reclaim them on your behalf.

settings.title: Why isn't my order shipped immediately upon payment?
settings.answer: With a socially conscious vision and an unwavering commitment to sustainability, we encourage our community of creatives and designers not to overproduce and operate on a made-to-order basis. In light of that, we hope you'll be patient with your order and allow extra time for our creators to craft the jewelry that will stand the test of time.

settings.title: Can I change my shipping address?
settings.answer: You can change your shipping address by contacting our customer service team if the order has not yet entered into manufacturing or has not yet shipped.

settings.title: Is my shipment insured?
settings.answer: Yes, all of our shipments are insured to provide you with added protection and peace of mind during transit.

settings.title: Shipping & handing
Am I eligible for a return or a refund?
settings.answer: Yes, you are eligible for a refund if the items you received are not of satisfactory quality or if they are different from what you ordered within 14 days of receiving the items. For more information about our Returns & Refunds policy, please click here.

settings.title: How do I package my item for return?
settings.answer: If possible, it is recommended that the item be packaged securely in its original packaging. However, if you encounter any difficulties with the original packaging, please contact our customer service team for further assistance.

settings.title: How long will it take to receive my refund?
settings.answer: We strive to complete your refund within 30 days as soon as we receive your returned items.

settings.title: Do I need to pay for return shipping?
settings.answer: No, we will cover the return shipping cost for you.

settings.title: How do I return a gift?
settings.answer: If you have received a gift from someone, you can follow the same return process as mentioned above.

settings.title: Can I return an engraved item?
settings.answer: Since made-to-order items are specially created for you, we can only accept returns if the items are damaged or faulty when delivered.

settings.title: Am I eligible for a replacement or repair?
settings.answer: To be eligible for a replacement product or repair, please ensure that you inform our customer service team as soon as you discover the alleged defect and, in any event, within 14 days of receiving the product.

settings.title: Can I request an exchange?
settings.answer:
We do not accept any request to exchange products you wish to return for other products, except where we sent you the wrong product. 

If you have any questions or require further clarification regarding our Return and Refund policy, please don't hesitate to contact our customer service team.

settings.title: Can I return a final sale and made-to-order item?
settings.answer: Final sale and made-to-order items are generally not eligible for return unless they arrive damaged or faulty when delivered.

settings.title: Returns & Exchanges
Are The Future Rocks items guaranteed authenticity?
settings.answer: We only sell products made with the highest-quality materials, design, and craftsmanship. We guarantee the authenticity of all products purchased through our website, and our team of specialists individually controls the quality of all our products.

settings.title: What’s The Future Rocks Counterfeit policy?
settings.answer:
We take counterfeiting very seriously and take legal action against any persons, stores, or websites that sell The Future Rocks counterfeit products. Counterfeiting is selling knockoff or imitation products as genuine The Future Rocks goods.

Counterfeit The Future Rocks products are typically of poor quality and lack the details and workmanship that make each The Future Rocks product high-quality.

Counterfeiting has been linked to organized crime, child labor, and terrorism.

settings.title: How do you select the jewelry designers you partner with?
settings.answer: We partner with future-forward jewelry designers who share our values of sustainability, innovation, and creativity. We assess our partner's commitment to responsible supply chains, circularity practices, and support towards social causes.

settings.title: Do you offer customization options?
settings.answer: Yes, we could offer customization options for select collections. Please get in touch with our customer service team to discuss your requirements and customization options.

settings.title: Is there a size guide to The Future Rocks’ offerings?
settings.answer: The size guide is available here. If you are buying jewelry as a gift or need advice, our customer service team is here to assist you.

settings.title: Do you offer resizing?
settings.answer: Yes, we provide complimentary resizing services for select items for 30 days and cover the shipping costs both ways. However, items like eternity rings, tennis bracelets, or personalized items are not eligible for resizing.

settings.title: How can I get help or advice about my purchase?
settings.answer: Please contact our customer service team to inquire about your personal shopper service. Our team is here to assist you with every aspect of your shopping experience, whether you need styling tips, gift suggestions, or personalized assistance.

settings.title: What is The Future Rocks warranty?
settings.answer: Jewelry purchased from The Future Rocks starting from June 16th, 2023, is warranted against any manufacturing defect for a period of 24 months from the date of purchase. This means they will repair or replace any jewelry piece with a defect caused during manufacturing, free of charge, within this timeframe.

settings.title: What should I do if my 2-year warranty expires?
settings.answer: Unfortunately, their warranty only covers manufacturing defects for 2 years. If your warranty has expired, any repairs or services will be subject to a service charge. You can contact our customer service team for more information and pricing regarding repairs after the warranty period.

settings.title: Under what condition can I repair my purchase from The Future Rocks?
settings.answer: The warranty only covers manufacturing defects, such as faulty clasps, loose stones due to poor setting, or broken chains. It does not cover damages resulting from misuse, negligence, accidents, or normal wear and tear.

settings.title: How do I process my warranty claim?
settings.answer: If your jewelry piece falls within the 2-year warranty period and seems to have a manufacturing defect, you can contact our customer service team. We will ask for photos of the damage and possibly the original purchase receipt. Once we confirm the issue is a manufacturing defect, we will arrange for repair or replacement, usually at no cost to you.

settings.title: Products
How do I find out about the latest promotions?
settings.answer: To learn about our latest promotions, subscribe to our email newsletter here or follow us on Instagram. Stay informed, and don't miss our exclusive deals and special offers.

settings.title: How do I apply a promo code?
settings.answer: To apply a promo code, simply paste it into the “Discount code or gift card” field on the checkout page. Please note that certain promo codes may have specific requirements or restrictions.

settings.title: How do I know if my item is eligible for a promotion?
settings.answer: Please check the details provided with the promo codes or on our website to determine whether your item is eligible.

settings.title: What if my promo code has expired?
settings.answer: Unfortunately, expired promo codes cannot be applied to your purchase. Please stay updated with our latest offers and promotions.

settings.title: Can I use multiple promo codes at once?
settings.answer: Our promo codes can generally be used one at a time per purchase. Please refer to the terms and conditions of the promo codes for specific details regarding their usage.

settings.title: Promotions
What materials do you use?
settings.answer: Science-powered materials, including recycled metals, lab-grown diamonds, and gemstones, are at the heart of all the pieces in our universe. We strive to make a powerful statement while leaving a gentler legacy.

settings.title: Does The Future Rocks offer products with sustainable certification?
settings.answer: Please refer to the Conscious Practices section under the product detail page. Our designers are committed to sustainable practices, and you can find information about their sustainability credentials there.

settings.title: Do you offer grading reports from independent laboratories?
settings.answer: We offer items featuring lab-grown diamonds and gemstones that come with grading reports from independent laboratories. Please contact our customer service team via email or online chat if you have any additional inquiries.

settings.title: What are lab-grown diamonds?
settings.answer: Lab-grown diamonds (LGDs), also known as man-made, cultured, or synthetic diamonds, are produced in a lab using advanced processes that replicate the natural geological process. They have the same physical, chemical, and optical properties as their natural counterparts. Learn more about lab-grown diamonds here.

settings.title: How are lab-grown diamonds made?
settings.answer: Lab-grown diamonds are created through chemical vapor deposition (CVD) or high-pressure high-temperature (HPHT) methods. Learn more about the process here.

settings.title: What are the 4Cs of diamonds?
settings.answer: Cut, clarity, color, and carat weight are most typically graded using this standard 4Cs method, considered the global standard for assessing diamond quality. Learn more about 4Cs here.

settings.title: What are the differences between HPHT and CVD diamonds?
settings.answer: The key difference between an HPHT diamond and a CVD diamond is in how they grow. The growth processes of HPHT and CVD diamonds result in distinct crystal structures, which could potentially be identified by a diamond expert under magnification and close inspection. Learn more about their differences here.

settings.title: What is recycled gold jewelry?
settings.answer: Recycled gold is produced by melting down and refining previously used gold from various sources, then using the purified gold to create new jewelry pieces. Learn more about recycled gold jewelry here.

settings.title: Why choose recycled metals?
settings.answer: Most of our partners use recycled metals sourced and recovered predominantly from discarded electronic devices that are then transformed into modern heirlooms. Not only will you look good in recycled jewelry, but you will also feel good knowing you are making a positive impact. Learn more about recycled gold jewelry here.

settings.title: Materials
How do I care for my diamonds?
settings.answer: Dissolve one tablespoon of mild dish soap into a glass of warm water and let your jewelry go for a little swim. Scrub gently with a soft cloth or an old soft-bristle toothbrush before rinsing with clean water. For more in-depth cleaning tips, visit here.

settings.title: How do I care for my gemstones?
settings.answer: Add three drops of lemon essential oil to a half cup of witch hazel or vinegar. Let your jewelry sit for five minutes, and wipe with a soft polishing cloth if necessary. Rinse with clean water.

settings.title: How do I care for my precious metals?
settings.answer:
For plated pieces:

When treating plated pieces, gentleness is key. Do not scrub or use a polishing cloth, as this will damage the coating. Rub the surface gently with a soft jewelry cloth. 

For raw brass and sterling silver jewelry, polish finish:

Make a paste using half a lemon and a teaspoon of baking soda. Rub the paste in your jewelry in one direction with a cotton cloth. Wipe off and rinse.

settings.title: What should I avoid doing with my jewelry?
settings.answer: Do your best to avoid exposure to direct sunlight and excessive heat. Secure your jewelry, especially silver, in a holder with individually lined compartments to avoid scratches.

settings.title: How often should I get my jewelry cleaned?
settings.answer: You should have your jewelry cleaned every few months, depending on how frequently you wear it and the type of metals and gemstones involved. Regular cleaning helps maintain its shine and prevents the buildup of dirt and oils.

settings.title: How should I store and organize my jewelry?
settings.answer: Store each piece of jewelry separately in a soft pouch or lined jewelry box to prevent tangling, scratches, and damage. Keep jewelry away from direct sunlight and extreme temperatures, and avoid storing it in humid areas such as bathrooms.

settings.title: Jewelry care
How can I contact customer service?
settings.answer: You can contact our customer service team through various channels, including email, chat on our website, or direct message on Instagram. Our contact information can be found on our website's Contact page.

settings.title: What are your customer service hours?
settings.answer: Our customer service hours are from 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM Hong Kong Time.

settings.title: How long does it take to receive a response from customer service?
settings.answer: We strive to respond to your inquiries as quickly as possible. Response times may vary depending on the volume of inquiries and the complexity of the issue. Typically, you can expect to receive a response within 24 to 48 hours.

settings.title: Do you offer live chat support?
settings.answer: Yes, you can click the “Chat with us” button on our website to receive support from our customer service team.

settings.title: How can I provide feedback or suggestions for improvement?
settings.answer: We highly value your feedback and suggestions for improvement. Don't hesitate to reach out to our customer service team; we are eager to hear from you. Your input helps us enhance our products and services to better meet your needs.

settings.title: Customer service
Do you offer complimentary engraving services?
settings.answer: Yes, we could offer engraving options for select collections. Please get in touch with our customer service team to discuss your requirements.

settings.title: Is it possible to send a gift anonymously?
settings.answer: You can send a gift anonymously by specifying a different shipping name and address to ensure your name is not associated with the package.

settings.title: Do you offer gift cards?
settings.answer: We offer gift cards in preset denominations of USD 250, 500, and 1,000, or you can choose a custom value. Please note that our gift cards are non-refundable.

settings.title: Am I eligible to buy a gift card?
settings.answer: We currently offer gift cards only to customers in the United States. We cannot accept or honor gift cards for international customers outside the United States.

settings.title: How do I purchase a gift card?
settings.answer: If you are a US-based customer, please shop for your gift card here. After completing the purchase, you will receive an order confirmation email and a separate email with a unique gift card code link will be sent to the recipient.

settings.title: Can I customize the gift card message?
settings.answer: You can customize the email message sent to the gift card recipient and choose a greeting card image.

settings.title: How do I use my gift card to make a purchase online?
settings.answer: Simply select any items you would like to purchase on our website and go to checkout. In the designated field, enter the code from your gift card. The gift card value will be applied to your total order amount.

settings.title: How can I check the remaining balance on my gift card?
settings.answer: To check the balance of your gift card, please visit our website anytime on the balance page here.

settings.title: What if I forgot or lost my gift card email?
settings.answer: Please reach out to our customer service team for assistance. We will assist you in retrieving the email and guide you on how to access and use your gift card.

settings.title: Gifting
What defines sustainable jewelry, and why is it important?
settings.answer:
The Future Rocks is a global marketplace for sustainable and future-forward jewelry.

As the world’s premier destination for innovative and future-forward lab-grown diamond jewelry, we offer an international portfolio of design-forward jewelry catering to a growing desire for greater transparency and social responsibility.

We ally with socially responsible designers and represent conscious products created from innovative science and materials.

Paving the way for sustainable elegance, we strive and advocate for product transparency in all our jewelry products. We envision a more honest future - where sustainability and inclusivity are vital at every stage of the product journey.

Learn more about our sustainable practices here.

settings.title: What is your commitment to sustainable sourcing practices?
settings.answer: We prioritize partnering with jewelry designers who align with our values and have made conscious decisions regarding their processes. It includes adopting responsible production methods, promoting transparency in their supply chains, using recycled or lab-grown materials, and supporting social causes. While we don’t have all the answers, we strive to do the right thing for future generations.

settings.title: Does The Future Rocks adhere to specific sustainability certifications or standards?
settings.answer: We are collaborating with sustainability certification partners to improve our business operations and minimize our environmental impact while demonstrating an equal passion for future-forward jewelry. Learn more about our progress and commitment to sustainability here.

settings.title: How is your packaging sustainable?
settings.answer:
For our jewelry boxes, we opt for FSC-certified paper made from eco-conscious materials. Our paper is environmentally friendly, guaranteed to be elemental chlorine-free, acid-free, devoid of heavy metals, and has a long lifespan. 

Furthermore, we utilize frustration-free postal boxes crafted from 90% recycled materials. These boxes are designed for easy opening and assembly, aligning with our commitment to sustainable practices.

We also offer Honeycomb Cushion Wrapping Paper, a kraft paper-based, eco-friendly, and cost-effective material that provides superior strength despite being lightweight. It is manufactured from renewable resources, biodegradable, 100% recyclable, and easy to dispose of.

settings.title: How can I make buying jewelry a more conscious choice?
settings.answer:
Here are some steps you can take:

  • Invest in timeless pieces: Choose jewelry made with solid gold, lab-grown diamonds, and precious stones, which are designed to last and can be passed down to future generations.
  • Choose recycled metals such as gold and sterling silver. These metals are indistinguishable from newly mined ones, so you don't have to compromise on quality.
  • Jewelry that gives back: Some labels donate a portion of their profits to causes and organizations.

Seek out sustainability certifications like the Responsible Jewelry Council (RJC), Positive Luxury, and B Corp. It puts a stamp of approval on their sustainable practices across the board.

settings.title: Sustainability
What is The Future Rocks’ membership program?
settings.answer: Our membership program offers exclusive perks such as early access to new releases, priority deal access, members-only offers, a special birthday treat, an extended return period, and much more. Joining is free, so be sure to sign up and start enjoying the exclusive benefits today.

settings.title: How do I sign up for my membership?
settings.answer: To become a member, sign up here and follow the registration process to create an account.

settings.title: How long is my membership valid?
settings.answer: Once you successfully sign up here, your membership becomes valid immediately and will remain active as long as you maintain an active account. Please note that member perks are subject to change without prior notice.

settings.title: Where can I find my membership perks?
settings.answer: Sign up or log in to your account page. Under My Account, click the Member Perks section to find your exclusive offers and promo codes.

settings.title: Is there a referral program for members to earn additional perks?
settings.answer: Please visit here for more information about our referral program.

settings.title: How do I purchase a members-only item?
settings.answer: To purchase a members-only item, log into your account here and navigate to the specific item's page. Please subscribe to our email newsletter here to stay informed about early drops and the latest offers for members.

settings.title: How do I reset my password?
settings.answer: To reset your password, navigate to our login page and click on the "Forgot Your Password?" option. Then, follow the instructions provided to reset your password.

settings.title: How do I update my account details & email preferences?
settings.answer: You can update your account details and email preferences by logging into your account here and accessing the Profile section.

settings.title: How can I opt out of communications about my membership?
settings.answer: You can manage your email preferences in your email settings or contact our customer service team for assistance. Please note that processing your request may take up to 14 business days.

settings.title: Membership
How do I sign up for The Future Rocks’ referral program?
settings.answer:
To join our referral program, follow these steps:

  • Visit the referral program page here.
  • Follow the registration process to create an account.
  • Once registered, you will receive a confirmation email with your unique referral link.

settings.title: How do you refer a friend?
settings.answer: Invite a friend with your unique referral link in your registration confirmation email. For the credit to be valid, make sure your friend uses this referral link at the time of their purchase. Please note that credits will not be allocated if the order is returned or refunded.

settings.title: Am I eligible to join the referral program?
settings.answer: The referral program is valid only for members in the United States. Prior spending is not required to participate in our referral program.

settings.title: How much can I earn for referring a friend?
settings.answer: You can earn a unique USD 30 shopping credit code upon each referee's completed transaction. Credits are allocated to your account automatically 30 days after the referee's order is delivered.

settings.title: Will my friend receive any perks from my referral?
settings.answer: Referees get 10% off on their first purchase via a referral link. Your referral will get rewarded 30 days after the order is delivered.

settings.title: How many friends can I refer to the program?
settings.answer: You can accumulate up to USD 600 shopping credits upon successful transactions made by all 20 referrals for purchases on thefuturerocks.com within the first year of membership registration.

settings.title: Can I use multiple codes at checkout?
settings.answer: You can use accumulated shopping by entering multiple shopping credit codes at checkout. You can also use these shopping credits in conjunction with any other promotions or gift cards.

settings.title: Am I automatically signed up for the referral program with my membership?
settings.answer: No, joining our referral program requires a separate registration process. You need to sign up for the referral program here.
